purpose: Pure-CPU scheduling-layer completion pilot over all 12 directed throughput channels in official CooperScene mcap_preview/9.mcap.

sourceArtifact.hashInterpretation: SHA-256 computed locally over the complete object; no publisher-supplied object hash was available.
sourceArtifact.downloadScope: No additional dataset or other large artifact was downloaded for this pilot.

calculator.simulationRule: Use the user-requested three-decimal CLI values 0.270, 0.282, 0.541, and 9.011 MB; retain the calculator's unrounded values as provenance.

temporaryMcapParser.method: Stream top-level MCAP records, zstd-decompress one chunk at a time, verify chunk CRC, and decode protobuf Vector3 throughput messages.

temporaryPilotImplementation.retentionReason: The requested repository change is restricted to one JSON result file.

versionedInputs.zstdVersion: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***

measurementContract.unitCaveat: Mbps is still inferred from the official cv2x_throughput configuration and benchmark documentation; the Vector3 schema does not encode a unit.
measurementContract.payloadMegabyteDefinition: Decimal MB: 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes; payload megabits = MB * 8.
measurementContract.piecewiseConstantRule: For sample i, Vector3.x applies on [log_time_i, log_time_(i+1)); integrate rate_Mbps * true interval_seconds. No right support is assumed for the final sample.
measurementContract.takeEndRule: Each link's observation ends at its own final throughput log_time. The final sample start has zero follow-up and every positive payload is right-censored there.
measurementContract.completionBoundaryRule: Completion at or before the per-link take end counts as completed. A 1e-12 megabit capacity epsilon and 1 ns time tolerance address floating-point boundary comparisons only.
measurementContract.nonpositiveRateRule: Observed values were finite and non-negative. Zero contributes zero capacity; a negative or non-finite value would fail the pilot rather than be clipped.

ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.issue: The producer does not specify how far the final throughput sample should extend beyond its timestamp.
ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.rule: Do not extrapolate it; censor at the final log_time.

ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.issue: All decoded throughput message sequence values are zero and cannot identify frames.
ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.rule: Use monotonic log_time only; make no perception-frame mapping.

ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.issue: The label 'iid permutation' can conflict with a permutation's without-replacement dependence.
ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.rule: Use a uniform random permutation without replacement, preserving each link's observed segment-rate multiset; do not sample with replacement.

ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.issue: A circular shift can be shared or link-specific.
ambiguitiesAndConservativeRules.rule: Use independently derived per-link offsets so per-link temporal order is preserved while absolute cross-link phase is perturbed.

surrogateSeeds.seedDerivation: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over condition_id|base_seed with |topic appended for independent-link operations
surrogateSeeds.prng: SplitMix64 with rejection-sampled randbelow and deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle

comparisonDesign.circularShiftOperationalization: Independent per-link circular offsets over the 160 observed interval rates.

estimandDefinitions.completionRate: Completed within observed per-link take support divided by all starts; separately report right-censoring.
estimandDefinitions.completionTime: Median and p95 use completed observations only. Right-censored starts are never assigned take-end time or any maximum delay.
estimandDefinitions.deadlineRate: Success if observed completion is at or before 100, 500, or 1000 ms. A noncompletion with at least that much follow-up is a known failure; a noncompletion censored earlier is excluded from the known-status denominator and reported separately.
estimandDefinitions.overall: Descriptive pooling of all 12 links and 161 starts per link; it is not an independent-sample estimand.
estimandDefinitions.surrogateSummary: For each surrogate condition, metrics are recomputed separately for every fixed seed and summarized across 100 repeat-level values. These repetitions are sensitivity transformations, not new acquisition units.
estimandDefinitions.absoluteDifferenceFromExact: Absolute condition-minus-exact difference for rates and completed-only median/p95. Null means one or both completion-time summaries are undefined because no sample completed.

exact-order.description: Original per-link segment order and original log-time intervals.

constant-1.6-mbps.description: Replace every observed segment rate on every link with 1.6 Mbps; retain every timestamp, start, payload, and follow-up horizon.

per-link-time-mean.description: Replace every segment on a link with that link's duration-weighted mean over its 160 observed intervals; retain every timestamp, start, payload, and follow-up horizon.

synchronous-iid-permutation.description: For each seed, apply one uniform without-replacement permutation of the 160 observed interval indices synchronously to all 12 links.

independent-link-iid-permutation.description: For each seed, apply an independently derived uniform without-replacement permutation of the 160 observed intervals to each link.

independent-link-circular-shift.description: For each seed, independently derive one circular offset per link and rotate its 160 observed interval values; timestamps and interval durations remain fixed.

inferenceBoundary.allowedInterpretation: Finite-take scheduling sensitivity and reproducibility check only.
inferenceBoundary.prohibitedInterpretation: Do not treat starts, directed links, or surrogate seeds as independent takes; do not generalize to CooperScene, CV2X deployments, or perception quality.

prohibitions: Do not call completion time measured end-to-end latency.
Do not treat right-censored observations as the maximum observed delay.
Do not claim packet-loss, jitter, queueing, contention, retransmission, or radio-causal effects from scalar throughput integration.
Do not claim the configured-inferred Mbps unit is embedded in the MCAP schema.
Do not map these starts to perception frames without a verified time-to-frame sidecar.
Do not treat any of the 100 surrogate repetitions as an additional independently collected take.
Do not infer perception accuracy or run a perception model from this pilot.
Do not generalize take 9 results to other takes or deployments.

resourceUse.residentDataScope: One decompressed MCAP chunk at a time plus 12 x 161 throughput rows and repeat-level metric accumulators.

checks: sample counts equal 1932 overall and 161 per link
completed plus right-censored counts equal all starts
completion plus right-censoring rates equal one
completed-only time counts equal completed counts and remain null when no completion exists
deadline known-status plus censored-before-deadline counts equal all starts
completion rate is non-increasing with payload size within every condition, repeat, and scope
constant 1.6 Mbps analytic sanity passes for every payload observable within the take

independentExactIntegrationCheck.method: Compare every exact-order prefix-search result with a separate forward segment loop.
